messages:
Rhea P: Quick sync thread 99	SI onboarding rehearsal tomorrow. Main risks: marketplace voucher redemption, partner entitlements, and HW voucher shipping window. Need final owners for each.
Omar J: Marketplace side: entitlements are set for `partner-org-8342`. Voucher redemption endpoint is stable. Risk is rate-limiting if all SIs hit it during lab. I'll enable a temporary higher quota for the rehearsal window.
Lea C: Can we provide a short sample curl for partners so they can test redemption beforehand? Also include how to inspect their entitlement via `GET /orgs/{id}/entitlement`.
Diego T: Trainers want two fallbacks: (1) pre-claimed hardware vouchers mapped to trainer accounts, (2) baked VM images we can drop into partner consoles. Which is fastest to stand up?
Omar J: Pre-claiming vouchers is easy; I can prebind 10 codes to trainer user ids. VM images take longer but are useful long-term. I'll queue 3 fallback images; ETA tonight.
InfraBot: infra-bot: quota bump applied for org `partner-org-8342` for window 2026-04-16T15:00:00Z - 2026-04-16T18:00:00Z.
Rhea P: Ownership recap:
- Marketplace & voucher redemptions: Omar
- Entitlement checks + partner access: Lea
- Trainer fallbacks + run order: Diego
- Logistics (HW shipping / voucher physical redemption): Rhea
Lock names please.
Lea C: Confirmed. I'll circulate the entitlement check snippet and a one-pager for partners on how to pre-test access.
Diego T: Confirmed. I'll add a 10min block in the runbook for voucher troubleshooting and a 5min incident-reporting blurb.
Omar J: I'll post prebound voucher list to the internal doc and DM trainers the codes. Also adding a short rate-limit retry example:
```
# exponential backoff sample
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -X POST "https://marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/vouchers/redeem" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"code":"SI-REHEARSAL-2026"}' || sleep $((2**i))
done
```
Rhea P: Great. Final ask: can everyone confirm by EOD today so I can hand the runbook to partners first thing tomorrow? :thumbsup:
Lea C: Done.
Omar J: Done.
Diego T: Done.
